## Context / Problem
Slice C1 (ticket 29a9-3cf7-3ded-42d8) recorded 11 below-seam ambient config/credential reads across the residual scattered readers (_logging, _opcert_signing, _operation_config, mirror_guard, review_bot/app, signing — 7 rows) AND the grounding subsystem (grounding/harness, grounding/oracle, grounding/resolve — 4 rows) as entries in `scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS`. These grounding rows belong to no earlier slice, so this residual slice folds them in alongside the other scattered readers. RP-04 is not complete while these ambient reads sit below the approved composition/credential/backend seams enforced by `scripts/check_config_ownership.py`. Parent: 075b-1479-dcb7-40ab.

Affected files (relative to `src/rebar/`):
  - `src/rebar/_logging.py`
  - `src/rebar/_opcert_signing.py`
  - `src/rebar/_operation_config.py`
  - `src/rebar/mirror_guard.py`
  - `src/rebar/review_bot/app.py`
  - `src/rebar/signing.py`
  - `src/rebar/grounding/harness.py` (L56: dynamic `os.environ.get`)
  - `src/rebar/grounding/oracle.py` (L170: `load_config()` below seam)
  - `src/rebar/grounding/resolve.py` (L62 import-time `REBAR_CTAGS_BIN` default capture; L543 `load_config()` below seam)

This slice drains the 11 residual/grounding rows (9 files). It does NOT assert whole-tree EMPTY: two `binding_lifecycle.py` rows (`RECONCILER_ABSENT_RETIRE_GRACE` + its `_env_int`/`os.environ.get` parser) are OUTSIDE this slice's scope — they were MOVED into `binding_lifecycle.py` by RP-02 S2 and their cut-to-seam is the RP-04 S7.3.a retarget tracked by ticket `01d8-c18d-b229-419a` (best-kingly-monkey). The whole-tree list reaches EMPTY only once BOTH this slice and that retarget land; whichever lands last observes EMPTY.

## Outcome
Every below-seam read in the files above is either (a) CUT to compose through the approved seam that already assembles config — the operation snapshot (`rebar._operation_config.OperationSnapshot` / `compose_operation_snapshot`), a startup binding, or the provider-credential boundary — or (b) for a genuine subsystem kill-switch / test-only control that has no place in the operation snapshot, annotated in place with an inline `# read-via: <reason>` marker on the reading line — the same established mechanism used by `_store/hlc.py`, `llm/gate_context.py`, and `_commands/session_id.py` — so the read is owned and self-documenting rather than whitelisted. Either way their `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` entries are removed (no path remains as a `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` row). `python scripts/check_config_ownership.py` reports zero findings for these paths with those entries gone and no path-glob exception. The subsystem's behavioral suites stay green; redacted operation-snapshot fingerprints / provider-neutral outcomes are unchanged except recorded, justified deltas.

## Plan
1. For each below-seam read in the listed files, classify as cut-to-seam or register-owned; for cut-to-seam, thread the value from the composition seam rather than reading ambient `os.environ`/`os.getenv`/`load_config` below it.
2. Remove the corresponding entries for these files from `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` in `scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py`.
3. Run `python scripts/check_config_ownership.py` and the subsystem behavioral suites (tests/unit signing/opcert/logging suites); keep green.

## Testing (RED -> GREEN)
- Held-out test `tests/scripts/test_residual_drain_seam_clean_heldout.py` asserts `check_config_ownership.check(check_config_ownership.REPO_ROOT)` returns no finding string containing any of the 9 listed paths, AND that none of the 9 listed paths remain as `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` rows (per-path membership check). It does NOT assert the whole list is EMPTY — the 2 residual rows are `binding_lifecycle.py` (owned by S7.3.a / `01d8-c18d-b229-419a`), outside this slice. RED now (entries present + reads below seam).
- The subsystem behavioral suites (tests/unit signing/opcert/logging suites + the grounding suites) stay green after the cutover — they are the correctness oracle the AST gate supplements.
- Redacted operation-snapshot fingerprints before/after are equal except recorded deltas.

## Compatibility / rollback
No stored ticket/event/binding format changes. A legacy facade is removed only after its focused suite passes; until then rollback selects the facade.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] No direct ambient config/credential read, backend reload, or configurable default remains below the approved seam in the 9 listed files; each is either cut-to-seam or annotated in place with an inline `# read-via: <reason>` marker (kill-switch / test-only control), and no path remains as a `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` row.
- [x] The `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` entries for these 9 files are removed from `scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py` (the only residual rows are the 2 `binding_lifecycle.py` entries owned by S7.3.a / `01d8-c18d-b229-419a`), and `python scripts/check_config_ownership.py` passes with no path-glob exception (proven by the held-out `test_residual_drain_seam_clean_heldout.py`).
- [x] The subsystem behavioral suites (tests/unit signing/opcert/logging + grounding suites) pass after the cutover; redacted operation-snapshot fingerprints / provider-neutral outcomes are unchanged except recorded approved deltas.
